Title: `getUserActivity` refuses a missing or malformed token
Steps: 1. POST `getUserActivity` with no Authorization header 2. repeat with `Bearer not-a-jwt`
Expected result: both refused (HTTP 401/403, or HTTP 200 with `status` 0) and no data returned

Title: `getUserActivity` treats an unknown scope as "all activity" (documented fallback)
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` 1; `data` is an array — `V2/AuthController.php:853-859` falls back to all activity for any scope other than recent/latest/weekly; no 5xx, no SQL text
